description: Lipo-C is a multi-component lipotropic preparation supplied as a ready-to-use solution rather than a lyophilized powder. Research use centres on lipid-transport and hepatic-metabolism models, where a defined liquid vehicle containing methyl-donor and lipotropic cofactors is required. Because the formulation is a blend, no single CAS number applies: the component list and the concentration of each component are stated on the batch Certificate of Analysis.

faq.question: What is Lipo-C?
faq.answer: Lipo-C is a multi-component lipotropic solution supplied for research use as a defined liquid vehicle; the component list and concentrations are stated on the batch COA rather than fixed in the catalogue.

faq.question: Why is there no CAS number for Lipo-C?
faq.answer: It is a blend of several components, so no single CAS number applies. Identity and composition are documented per batch on the Certificate of Analysis.

faq.question: How is Lipo-C shipped and stored?
faq.answer: It ships as a 10 mL multi-dose solution and should be stored at 2–8 °C protected from light; do not freeze unless your own stability data supports it.

faq.question: Can the formulation be customised?
faq.answer: Yes. Custom component ratios and labelling are available for OEM projects, subject to a written specification agreed before production.

faq.question: What bulk pricing applies?
faq.answer: Lipo-C is priced per 10-vial kit with tiered wholesale discounts from 10% at 5+ kits to 30% at 50+ kits.
